title: ABS System Configuration Error
shortDescription: PCM detected: abs system configuration error.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates abs system configuration error. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Reduced braking performance possible — drive with caution and inspect promptly.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect brake control component wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect brake control component and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; avoid heavy load.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.

fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect shift solenoid and clear codes.
